requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: EDR (elemento distintivo della retribuzione) omitted. Art. 65 I qualifies it as 'ove spettante'; amount not stated in Allegato 9 or CCNL body. Legacy entitlement for pre-privatization workers only.
requirements.remediation: Model the EDR for pre-privatization workers once its amount is sourced.

requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: INPS industria rates applied. Poste Italiane employees are enrolled in the Fondo Quiescenza Poste (INPS special fund, Art. 7 L. 335/1995; merged from IPOST 2012). Correct rates differ from standard industria rates. Verify against INPS Fondo Quiescenza Poste documentation. Verified 2026-09-09: INPS website confirms Fondo Quiescenza Poste exists for Poste Italiane SpA but specific aliquote not publicly listed on INPS portal in machine-readable form.
requirements.remediation: Source the Fondo Quiescenza Poste rates and apply them in place of the industria rates.

requirements.rule: Art. 63 legacy individual seniority (RIA) is worker-specific: for a known monthly balance pass IndividualElement(code='legacy_ria', monthly=<worker balance>, absorbable=False, as_of=None, extra_months=True, tfr_relevant=True). Arts. 67–68 include it in both extra months and Art. 78 includes it in TFR. Differentiated economic positions are also worker-specific and belong to both extra months and TFR, but Art. 63 permits absorption only upon promotion to a higher level or pay position, not on every increase of the minimum; generic absorbable=True does not express this condition. No balance can be inferred from the agreement.
requirements.remediation: Supply the worker's RIA as the non-absorbable individual element described above. For differentiated economic positions, obtain the worker's balance and implement promotion-only absorption; do not use generic minimum-increase absorption.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
